record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: Let Π(n) be the product of the decimal digits of n, and let P_m(n) be the first positive integer for which the iterates of Π stabilize, in the sense that Π^{P_m(n)}(n) = Π^{P_m(n)+1}(n). Determine whether P_m(n) ≤ 11 for every natural number n.

evidence.quote: Problem 31 (Conjecture of multiplicative persistence) . Given n∈N, let Π(n)∈N be the product of all its digits. Set Pm(n)∈N for the ﬁrst positive integer such that Π Pm(n)(n) = Π Pm(n)+1(n) ... Is it true that for all n∈N, Pm(n)≤11?

artifact.self_contained_problem: For a positive integer n, let Π(n) denote the product of the decimal digits of n. Define iterates by Π^1(n) = Π(n) and Π^{k+1}(n) = Π(Π^k(n)) for k ≥ 1. Let P_m(n) be the smallest positive integer k such that Π^k(n) = Π^{k+1}(n) (equivalently, the first time the iteration reaches a single decimal digit). Decide whether P_m(n) ≤ 11 holds for every positive integer n.
artifact.status_search_result: Sloane's multiplicative persistence conjecture (bound 11) remains open in general. The smallest number known with persistence exactly 11 is 277777788888899, and computer searches show any counterexample would have more than ~30,000 digits. Recent partial progress (2021) establishes the conjecture for odd multiplicative digital root targets, but the case of even targets remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Persistence of a number - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The multiplicative persistence is conjectured to be at most 11; any counterexample would have more than 30,000 digits.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture remains open with extensive computational verification.

status_evidence.title: The Multiplicative Persistence Conjecture Is True for Odd Targets
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the conjecture in the case of odd multiplicative digital root targets.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on Sloane's conjecture; even targets remain open.

status_evidence.title: A003001 - OEIS
status_evidence.snippet: Smallest number of multiplicative persistence n; the smallest with persistence 11 is 277777788888899.
status_evidence.claim: Bound 11 is achieved, no larger persistence known.
